strategy.rationale: Family Court adult discretionary expungement is now carrier-backed, but the principal petition binary is still absent. Form 1021IP names the packet as Form 281 (petition) plus Form 283 (proposed order); the canonical bundle carries neither, only the Form 281E charge-sheet continuation. A packet cannot be produced from a continuation sheet and an instruction booklet.

candidatesExaminedAndRejected.whatItActuallyIs: Superior Court Petition for Expungement of Adult Record, form ids CIV_EXP_02_A (Updated 6/1/2024) and CIV_EXP_02_B printed in its own page text; 1 page, 44 AcroForm fields, no XFA; decrypted by qpdf from LegalEase Delaware/download.aspx.pdf (sha256 f2820f713b9f8e0fb1c0095886e7184d56fda06eef7f65af014ab48922b7839a).
candidatesExaminedAndRejected.rejectedBecause: It is the Superior Court petition. Per Form 1021IP a petitioner whose charges were all disposed of in Family Court files in Family Court on Form 281; the Superior Court form is the correct instrument only when some charge falls outside Family Court, which is a different track.

candidatesExaminedAndRejected.whatItActuallyIs: Family Court PETITION FOR EXPUNGEMENT OF ADULT RECORD CHARGE SHEET — a DOCX continuation sheet whose own text says the charges continue a list on the petition to which it is attached.
candidatesExaminedAndRejected.rejectedBecause: Right court, wrong component. A continuation sheet cannot be the principal petition, and converting it to PDF would not create one. Master Library Edition 1.3 reached the same conclusion by re-roling it from PETITION to CONTINUATION_SHEET.

candidatesExaminedAndRejected.rejectedBecause: An instruction packet is not a substitute for the principal form. It is retained as the venue and packet-composition carrier, not as a filing instrument.

legalIntegrityDisposition: Deferred on a missing principal form, with the venue premise now carrier-backed. No participant-facing statement rests on an uncommitted source: every claim below traces to a verbatim quote in a pinned carrier. Reconstructing Form 281 from the charge sheet and the instruction packet would mint a form id and revision no byte supports.

participantTreatment.whyNoPacket: LegalEase cannot prepare this petition because the official Family Court petition form (Form 281) and its proposed order (Form 283) are not available to us as documents. We will not rebuild an official court form from an instruction booklet.
participantTreatment.whatTheParticipantIsTold: Delaware Family Court handles discretionary adult expungement when every charge and conviction on your record was handled in Family Court. If anything on your record was handled outside Family Court, the whole request goes to Superior Court instead. LegalEase cannot prepare the Family Court petition for you yet, so here is exactly what to request and where to file it.
participantTreatment.receivingAuthority: Family Court of the State of Delaware, Intake Office, in the county where your most recent case was terminated (New Castle, Kent or Sussex) — but Superior Court for that county if any charge or conviction on your record was handled outside Family Court.
participantTreatment.nextStep: Ask the Family Court Intake Office or the Family Court website for the Adult Expungement Instruction Packet (Form 1021IP), which contains the Petition (Form 281) and the Proposed Order (Form 283). Request your certified criminal history from the State Bureau of Identification, have the petition notarized, and file the original plus one copy.
whatToGather: A certified criminal history report from the State Bureau of Identification (it expires after 45 days)
The SBI cover letter that comes with it
Photo identification for the Intake Office
Your case numbers and the county where each case was handled
whatNotToFileOrRelyOn: Do not file the Superior Court expungement petition for an all-Family-Court record — it is a different court’s form
Do not use Form 281E on its own: it is only the continuation sheet for extra charges and attaches to Form 281
Do not treat the instruction packet as the petition
Do not rely on any LegalEase-generated document for this route — none exists
participantTreatment.briefcasePreservation: The Briefcase keeps your screening answers, your eligibility result and this handoff, including the court and county identified for you, so nothing you entered is lost. When the official form becomes available the route resumes from what you already provided.

f2CorrectionRecord.whatWasWrong: The treatment asserted adult Family Court jurisdiction under 11 Del. C. § 4374(c) and routed the participant there, with no committed carrier: "4374(c)" appears nowhere in DE-delaware.json, whose only venue statement puts discretionary adult expungement in Superior Court and Family Court in the juvenile context. The same uncorroborated premise was used to reject the committed Superior Court petition, so if the premise failed the rejection failed with it.
f2CorrectionRecord.whatTheEvidenceActuallyShows: Family Court publishes its own Adult Expungement Instruction Packet. Discretionary expungement is handled by BOTH courts, and the dividing line is the composition of the record: a petitioner whose charges are all Family Court files in Family Court; any charge or conviction outside Family Court sends the whole filing to Superior Court. The petition is Form 281 with a Form 283 proposed order, and Form 281E is the charge-sheet continuation.

en.whyNoPacket: We cannot prepare this petition because Delaware Family Court’s official petition form is not available to us as a document.
en.whereToGo: File in Family Court in the county where your most recent case ended — unless any charge on your record was handled outside Family Court, in which case you file in Superior Court.
en.nextStep: Ask Family Court Intake for the Adult Expungement Instruction Packet, Form 1021IP. It contains the petition and the proposed order.
en.gather: Bring a certified criminal history from the State Bureau of Identification, its cover letter, and photo identification. The criminal history expires after 45 days.
en.doNotRely: Do not file the Superior Court form for an all-Family-Court record, and do not file the charge sheet by itself.
en.briefcase: Your answers and this handoff stay in your Briefcase, so nothing is lost.
en.noCharge: You are not charged for this route and no packet credit is used.

es.whyNoPacket: No podemos preparar esta peticion porque el formulario oficial de peticion del Tribunal de Familia de Delaware no esta disponible para nosotros como documento.
es.whereToGo: Presentela en el Tribunal de Familia del condado donde termino su caso mas reciente, salvo que algun cargo de su historial se haya tramitado fuera del Tribunal de Familia, en cuyo caso debe presentarla en el Tribunal Superior.
es.nextStep: Solicite en la oficina de admision del Tribunal de Familia el paquete de instrucciones para la eliminacion de antecedentes de adultos, formulario 1021IP. Contiene la peticion y la orden propuesta.
es.gather: Lleve un historial penal certificado de la Oficina Estatal de Identificacion, su carta de presentacion, e identificacion con fotografia. El historial penal vence a los 45 dias.
es.doNotRely: No presente el formulario del Tribunal Superior si todo su historial es del Tribunal de Familia, y no presente la hoja de cargos por si sola.
es.briefcase: Sus respuestas y esta entrega permanecen en su Briefcase, para que no se pierda nada.
es.noCharge: No se le cobra por esta ruta y no se usa ningun credito de paquete.
